Subject: Gates & confluence: MSA / DPA / Order form sequencing and close timeline

Elaine — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I attached a draft mutual action plan (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) that pulls together the evaluation milestones, legal review windows, and the order-form/PO handoff. High-level asks:

- Can you confirm the internal approval committee date range (we heard early July from procurement on the call)?
- Who owns the initial PO upload in your system (procurement team or finance)?
- Any hard constraints on the DPA review cadence (e.g., privacy council only meets weekly on Fridays)?

Draft sequencing we propose in the MAP:
1) Evaluation wrap: 1 week (customer QA + final run) — target complete by 2026-06-24
2) Legal redlines: 10 business days for initial review (Karthik to send redline baseline by 6/4)
3) DPA parallel review: privacy council window (we expect signoff by 7/02 if council meets 6/25/7/02)
4) Order form / PO: procurement issues PO once legal signs; Redwood to provide final order-form PDF within 24 hours of signature.

I've called out owners in column C of the MAP. I also attached a single doc with our latest DPA redlines so your legal team can preview (DPA-Redlines_v3.docx).

If the dates above are off, tell us what moves. We want to avoid a linear handoff that blocks onboarding. Happy to run a short 30-min sync with procurement + legal if helpful.

Thanks,
Priyom
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Priyom — appreciate the clear MAP. Quick answers from procurement:

- Our executive procurement committee meets the first Friday of the month. For June that’s 06/04 (short notice) and then 07/02. Given timelines, 07/02 is the realistic sign date for any contract with executive spend >$100k.
- PO issuance: Procurement issues a preliminary PO number once legal confirms pricing/terms; finance does the final attachment to the AP system (usually 48–72 hrs after procurement issues the PO).
- Privacy council: meets every other Friday — next meetings are 06/11 and 06/25. The council needs a 72-hr review window ahead of the meeting to place DPA on the agenda.

A couple of flags from our side:
1) We have a standard indemnity amendment that legal will likely ask to adjust — that can add one review cycle.
2) Our procurement needs the final SSO/SCIM confirmation sheet before approving the order form (security/ops need to test the SSO flow).

We can do a 30-min alignment on Thursday 06/04 at 10:00am PT if Redwood can confirm who from legal will join (Karthik?), and if you can push an updated MAP with the revised DPA timeline beforehand.

Best,
Elaine
Sr. Program Manager, Procurement
Medora Health

Subject: Re: Gates & confluence: MSA / DPA / Order form sequencing and close timeline

Elaine/Priyom — adding legal context and a small proposed sequencing tweak so Medora doesn't get blocked by a single-thread DPA loop.

Summary of proposed approach:
- We will circulate a clean MSA + tracked DPA redline set internally by 06/04 EOD (attached baseline to this thread).
- Request Medora legal to return comments within 7 business days (target 06/15). If comments are extensive, we propose a focused redline call week of 06/16.
- To reduce risk, Redwood proposes signing the MSA (commercial terms set) first and executing the DPA as an addendum that can be finalized within 10 business days post-MSA signature. This allows procurement to issue a PO tied to the signed MSA and accelerate onboarding while privacy council finalizes the DPA addendum.

Critical constraints to call out:
1) Any material change to data residency or subprocessors in the DPA will require additional review from our privacy and infra teams and could push the DPA timeline by 2+ weeks.
2) We can prepare a limited-scope SSO/SCIM acceptance checklist for procurement/security to sign off (we'll share the checklist by 06/05).

If Medora accepts the MSA-first approach, suggested dates:
- MSA signature target: 2026-06-25 (to be presented to procurement exec on 07/02)
- Order form finalization & PO issuance: within 48–72 hrs after MSA signature
- DPA finalization: target 2026-07-09 (assuming privacy council slot on 06/25 or 07/02)

I'll attach the baseline bundle now. Happy to join the 06/04 alignment call — I'll make time at 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick recap and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Alignment call confirmed: Thu 06/04, 10:00am PT (we'll send calendar invite). Karthik joining from legal; Marissa (CS) will cover onboarding/SSO checklist; Laura will own billing/PO handoff details.
2) Redwood will adopt MSA-first with DPA as addendum unless Medora legal requires DPA-in-hand to issue the PO. If that changes, please flag on the call.
3) Action items:
   - Redwood: circulate updated MAP (v1.1) with explicit owner cells and the SSO checklist by 06/05 EOD. (Priyom)
   - Redwood legal: finalize and share clean MSA + tracked DPA redlines by 06/04 COB. (Karthik)
   - Medora procurement: confirm procurement exec calendar availability and whether a preliminary PO number can be issued ahead of final AP attachment. (Elaine / procurement)

Attachments: we will also place a pre-populated order-form PDF (OrderForm-Redwood-PO.pdf) in the folder after legal signs; that helps your procurement team validate line-item codes.

Risks called out: indemnity amendment and any subprocessor changes in the DPA are the two highest-likelihood timeline slack points. We will flag both in the MAP and provide mitigation notes (alternate language suggestions) during the call.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround and we'll be ready on the call.

Best,
Priyom
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
